title: Clean Food, Good Taste
topic: ข่าว/ข้อมูล
lines: Street food is one of the main reasons tourists choose Thailand. A survey
of 5,000 visitors found that 82 percent tried street food during their
trip, and nearly half said **it** was the highlight of their holiday.
Pad thai and mango sticky rice were the most popular dishes, while
som tam was named the spiciest.
However, the survey also showed concerns. About one in four visitors
worried about hygiene, and **some** said they had avoided certain stalls
because **they** looked dirty. In response, Bangkok has started a "Clean
Food, Good Taste" program. Vendors who pass a hygiene check receive a
green sign to display at **their** stalls.
So far, more than 3,000 vendors have joined. **Those** with green signs
report that their sales have increased by about 15 percent. City officials
hope the program will protect both tourists' health and the reputation of
